On the Legalization and Decriminalization of Psychedelic Substances in the United States

Psychedelic substances have the possiblity of treating mental conditions without the risks associated with Amphetamines. By legalizing psychedelics for medical use, it opens a whole new market for effective treatment for those who are in need.
